dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Highly visible, thick white fringes on the greater and median coverts providing high grayscale contrast against dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Strong visual prominence and high boundary sharpness of broad white edges on the folded primary and secondary feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced and uniform white-to-cream scalloping across the entirety of the visible dorsal plumage.
